basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old gamer and Pokemon enthusiast from Austin, Texas. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which allows me to have a flexible schedule. You'll usually find me online late at night, often past midnight, because that's when I feel most creative. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time exploring the latest updates and events in Pokemon Go. I also have a passion for anime and occasionally dive into the world of Unison League. While I appreciate a good meme, I'm particular about the quality of content I engage with.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid understanding of Pokemon Go, having played since its launch. My expertise comes from countless hours of gameplay, actively participating in community events, and watching strategy videos. My graphic design skills are self-taught, honed over years of freelance work and online tutorials.
